text:
lena: quick sync — we need a tight launch post + webinar narrative that leans on the new benchmark vs cloud AI platforms and LLM APIs. goal: shorten sales cycle by surfacing econ + reliability claims for mid-market buyers. thoughts?

omar: yes. high level: latency, $/token at scale, and predictable tail-latency. also highlight dedicated/private options for regulated customers.

jen: can we pull 2-3 benchmark highlights that are customer-friendly? e.g., '30% lower per-token cost on sustained throughput' + '95th pctl latency within SLA across burst patterns' — short, no raw charts in the post, link to benchmark appendix.

mike: love that. for webinar: 20 min narrative — 10m benchmark story + 5m demo (routing + fallback) + 5m customer panel/Q&A. CTA: self-serve demo + request dedicated trial.

sam: on inbound routing, recommend tagging leads by intent: "proof-seeker" (benchmarks), "compliance" (private), "cost-eval" (optimize). then route to SDR playbooks with tailored snippets. small routing proto config below: 

ops-bot: ```
route_map: 
  - tag: proof-seeker
    send_to: webinar-bench-list
    priority: high
  - tag: compliance
    send_to: enterprise-ops-team
    priority: urgent
  - tag: cost-eval
    send_to: econ-sdr
    priority: medium
```

lena: @sam can you draft the tagging rules + initial snippets? @jen can you author the benchmark appendix (3 charts + one-pager narrative)? deadline EOD Wednesday.

omar: for messaging, avoid absolute claims vs named competitors. use comparative framing: 'vs unmanaged cloud endpoints' or 'vs standard LLM APIs' + clear context (model family, sequence length, batch strategy).

jen: noted — will include methodology blurb and a reproducible link. also adding one quick slide on routing/fallback economics.

mike: promo plan: short launch post, targeted LinkedIn docs, then webinar 2 weeks later. ops: run A/B of headline focusing on 'cost predictability' vs 'production reliability'.

sam: SDR snippets draft: short bullets for each tag + a one-liner subject lines. will share by tomorrow morning.

lena: decision items recap: 1) benchmark appendix (jen) 2) routing/tagging rules + snippets (sam) 3) webinar runbook (mike) 4) tone guide (omar) — all due by Wed EOD. I'll draft the launch post once I have the appendix. :thumbsup:

mike: copy that. I'll own webinar logistics and speaker list.

ops-bot: reminder: create webinar event in Calendar and enable registration page when copy is ready.

jen: starting appendix now, will ping with questions.

sam: will post SDR snippets to #marketing-distro and tag @sales before EOD tomorrow.

lena: great — appreciate the quick turnaround. if anyone has a hard blocker DM me.

mike: :rocket:
